profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with hands-on experience designing, building and scaling enterprise-grade systems. Proven expertise in developing clean, reusable code and applying various design principles to build maintainable and scalable applications and services.  Adept at both leading and collaborating with development teams to achieve objectives and deliver feature-rich applications efficiently.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Create, enhance, and support scalable, reliable, resilient and maintainable backend applications (e.g. data pipeline monitoring, identity and access services) using Python and Rust.
•	Develop and maintain API solutions for web and backend platforms, including services built with REST, GraphQL, and RPC patterns.
•	Build responsive front-end features for data operators to perform actions on data pipeline, with React and connect them effectively to backend systems.
•	Engineer microservices and distributed application components that support scalability and long-term maintainability of identity management systems. 
•	Partner with product, design, and infra teams to deliver technical solutions aligned with business needs such as developing an automated license reclamation solution to deprovision inactive users from third-party applications.
•	Investigate production issues, monitor applications health, resolve incidents in cloud-hosted environments, and implementing solutions to automate the handling of recurring and related issues.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Create, enhance, and support scalable, reliable, resilient and maintainable web application using PHP.
•	Develop and maintain API solutions for web platforms, including services built with REST and SOAP.
•	Design and develop cloud-based web application architectures and manage deployments across services such as compute, storage, serverless, and databases.
•	Improve system efficiency by tuning application performance, refining database interactions, and managing cloud resource usage.
•	Apply secure development practices by implementing authentication, authorization, and other application security controls.
•	Support automated delivery workflows and container-based deployment processes using Docker and CI/CD tools.
•	Investigate production issues, monitor application health, and resolve incidents in cloud-hosted environments.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and implement custom web applications for high-traffic e-commerce systems and integrated third-party platforms, such as, payment and CMS applications for multiple clients and projects.
•	Improve system efficiency by tuning application performance, refining database interactions, and managing cloud resource usage for multiple clients and projects.
•	Investigate production issues, monitor application health, and resolve incidents in cloud-hosted environments for multiple clients and projects.
